proof_body:
by
  intro R _ P _
  let x : PrimeSpectrum R := ⟨P, inferInstance⟩
  have hne : Nonempty (PrimeSpectrum R) := ⟨x⟩
  have hq : ringKrullDim (R ⧸ P) = (Order.coheight x : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
    rw [ringKrullDim_quotient, Order.coheight_eq_krullDim_Ici]
    rfl
  have hh : P.height = Order.height x := PrimeSpectrum.height_eq_orderHeight x
  have hk : ringKrullDim R = ((⨆ a : PrimeSpectrum R, Order.height a + Order.coheight a : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) :=
    Order.krullDim_eq_iSup_height_add_coheight_of_nonempty
  rw [hq, hh, hk, ← WithBot.coe_add]
  exact WithBot.coe_le_coe.2 (le_iSup (fun a : PrimeSpectrum R => Order.height a + Order.coheight a) x)
target_source: ∀ (R : Type*) [CommRing R] (P : Ideal R) [P.IsPrime], (P.height : WithBot ℕ∞) + ringKrullDim (R ⧸ P) ≤ ringKrullDim R
